summary:
Coverage audit of spec v4.1 Part 1 §1 Terms, §2 CF-1–CF-7, §3 BD-1–BD-9, §4 AR-1–AR-8 and the Appendix A cases about cards, the board and arrows (A7–A22, A24–A26, A29; A1–A6, A23, A27, A28 left out as review/frozen/undo/session cases). 209 rows: 150 built, 23 planned-slice2, 21 planned-slice3, 5 for-slice4, 2 for-slice5, 2 narrowed-by-decision, 4 contradicted, 2 unassigned.

Abbreviations in 'where': core/, webview/ and runner/ mean packages/<pkg>/src/. S1 is docs/slice1-plan.md, S2 is docs/slice2-plan.md, and S3 is /tmp/claude-1000/-home-zhengyew-telelean/20626c17-0334-4498-ad86-9dc24b7010ed/scratchpad/plans/slice3-plan.md (under review and may change). Slice-2 rows count as planned even where 2a1/2a2 already wrote their core texts and types (S2 §8): no review UI, judgeState B.3/B.4 or propose_arrow is built yet.

UNASSIGNED (2):
1. CF-6, second half: when you edit a sentence Claude wrote, it should become yours. core/edit/planAction.ts:85-125 (edit-node) never clears `worded_by: agent`, and no plan commits to it. S3's D3-44 only freezes the edited field.
2. AR-7: the drop zone should name the frozen arrows that a move to AXIOMS would remove. Today kindChangeImpact gives only a count. No S3 section mentions the drop zone or kind-change impact.

CONTRADICTED (4):
1. AR-6: an axiom made a proposition should land next to its new source. Instead it gets the generic layered placement (planArrows.ts:126-130 drops its stored position; placement.ts:103 places it).
2. BD-7: definitions and presuppositions should be named on a chip on the band. They appear only as tooltip lines (band.ts:99-104), and the definitions come from the statement closure rather than from what the proof relies on. S1 §4 chose this; no AP or D decision records it.
3. A19: an old axiom's `premises:` arrows should be shown as "declared before v4". They are not drawn at all (subjectGraph.ts:64-66); only a card chip says so.
4. BD-3/B.7/AP-12 say positions are written only by moves and Tidy layout. In fact a card from the A|P box (and from "New proposition here") has its computed position written at creation (S1 §2.4, §8 1c1). It is needed to keep BD-8's placement, but no decision logs it.

NARROWED (2):
1. D2-15: Claude never splits a Shaky card (CF-3). S3 says D2-15 also stays in slice 4.
2. D2-65: AR-8's "result not shown yet" dialog is replaced by Formalize being disabled until the stage's results are shown.

Further caveats:
- AR-3 "blocks Apply": only implied, through the S2 §4.10 backstop's `cycle` (B.3 restated on F). §4.9 judgeState explicitly ignores a cycle already in B.
- AR-3 "blocks Formalize": slice 1 blocks only when the target or a source lies on the cycle.
- S3 D3-38: with the whole model open, propose_arrow accepts "any unfrozen proposition". The plan does not say whether cards marked "follows from nothing" are excluded (AR-5, B.3, TL023).
- D3-43: A25 and "Claude may add cards" may move to slice 4.
- D3-6 narrows when marks and Dependencies can be frozen.
- D2-35 shows Add-premise drafts at the top of the AXIOMS column, as slice 1's ghost cards already did.

rows.requirement: An axiom card is something you hold, sits in the AXIOMS column, has a Lean axiom .holds, and replaces ASSUMPTION.

X → Y claims Y follows at least in part from X; dotted while only declared, solid once a checked proof of Y uses X.

rows.requirement: The green band binds the arrows a checked proof uses, which together suffice.
Established = proved, resting only on axiom cards, presuppositions and definitions, never on a pending claim, with current facts; shown as the green glow.
'Axiom' alone names the card; 'Lean axiom' names an axiom declaration (an axiom card's .holds, a pending claim, a presupposition or a hidden assumption).

rows.note: S2 §5.4 and §5.6 use the wording 'Not needed'.

rows.requirement: A proof that uses none of the selected arrows is 'proved from nothing', flagged.
From slice 2, when Claude needs a card with no drawn arrow, it proposes an arrow item.
rows.note: D2-21: only from a card with a .holds.

rows.requirement: If the target's Dependencies are frozen, Claude makes an unfreeze request instead.
In slice 1 Claude finishes not proved naming that card, the report offers 'Draw (or select) the arrow…', and Claude never proposes an existing card as a premise.
rows.where: webview/model/run.ts:555 (missingArrowHints); S1 §8 1e (prompts, B.2 for Claude suggests)

rows.requirement: An arrow you drew but did not select is listed as 'select ‹card› → ‹target› too'.
rows.note: S2 §5.4 adds a 'Select these arrows' button.

rows.requirement: Asking again about an already-proved proposition: a passing new proof replaces the old one and the band moves.
rows.where: S1 §8 fixer 1e (a new proof replaces; a not-proved finish keeps the old one)

rows.requirement: The Result says 'replaces your proof' and lists the cards whose basis changes.
In a chain X → L → A, L is proved first; if L fails, A's step reports 'L was not proved', and ★D7 applies when A is retried alone.
A pending proposition dragged into AXIOMS becomes an axiom again, keeping its axiom n.holds; only kind and arrows change.
A proved proposition that others use, moved to AXIOMS, keeps their proofs building, and established cards stay established.
rows.where: core/kindChange.ts:204-210 ('proofs that use it stay valid'); B.5 in build.ts:927

rows.requirement: An arrow into an axiom that proofs use makes it pending; the cards resting on it lose the green glow, and the gesture says how many first.
Deleting an arrow a proof uses leaves a TL107 warning arrow and a band without ✓, and the delete confirmation says so.
If a proposal removes A → Z and adds Z → A, the addition depends on the removal, and declining the removal declines the addition.
rows.where: S2 §4.5 rule 4 (dependency rule built in 2a2); S3 §3.10 and §6.1 (3c1: Remove arrow items, A17 test)

rows.requirement: Arrows between subjects are not allowed (TL121).
In old files, ASSUMPTION reads as an axiom, and DERIVATION and GOAL read as propositions.
An old DERIVATION or GOAL whose .holds is a Lean axiom reads as pending.
Nothing in an old file is rewritten until you change that card's kind.
rows.where: S1 §2.2 (aliases never rewritten; type: written only on add-node or kind change)

rows.requirement: An old axiom block with premises: stays an axiom, and its arrows are shown as 'declared before v4' and cannot be selected.
rows.note: The arrows are not drawn at all; only a card chip says 'declared before v4'. No AP or D decision records this.

rows.requirement: A chip on such an axiom offers 'Make it a proposition (pending)' or 'Drop these arrows'.
A hand-written proof that uses a card with no arrow shows that use solid in the warning colour, never inside a band, and the band has no ✓.
A right-drag that ends on a card only pans, with no selection change and no menu.
When you draw an arrow into a card marked 'follows from nothing', the mark goes, and Undo restores it.
The mark goes even if it is frozen, because freezes bind only Claude.
rows.where: S3 §3.1 ('the person's arrow into a card replaces its mark, even a frozen one')

rows.requirement: telelean places only cards with no stored position, and Tidy layout moves only the selected cards.
With 'Claude may add cards' on, an unproved intermediate's Result says so, and any target that needed it reports '‹card› was not proved'.
rows.note: The dependent target's '‹card› was not proved' report is not spelled out. Under D3-43's fallback this may move to slice 4.

rows.requirement: A missing premise accepted as a pending proposition leaves the target proved but without the green glow until the premise is proved.
A card used only through a @[simp] lemma or an instance is still found by direct(v).
